title: Early striking results and why we got nervous
text: Board, a panel, specialists challenging each other until the truth surfaces. The research on multi-agent AI backs the intuition, models that critique each other can catch errors a lone model sails right past. A lone model has one blind spot and no way to see it. Three models with different remits have to make their disagreement explicit before they can resolve it. We ran it on the flagged uncertain cases, the exact eyes the classifier struggled with, and the early results were striking.
